slides.texte_overlay:
how you become more
attractive without looks
Have a sense of humour about life. Laughing easily, telling funny stories, not taking yourself too seriously. Humour is attractive at any age.
Be passionate about something. Music, sport, cooking, building things. A man who lights up when he talks about what he loves is magnetic.
Be kind to everyone around you. Waiters, strangers, your friends. Kindness is noticed, and it says more about you than any outfit.
Keep your word. If you say you'll call, call. If you say you'll come, come. Reliability makes people feel safe with you, and that's deeply attractive.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Curiosity makes you more interesting than any haircut ever could.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Curiosity makes you more interesting than any haircut ever could.

slides.texte_overlay: Smell good and stay clean. A fresh shirt, a light scent, clean nails. Small grooming habits make a big difference without changing your face.
Be emotionally steady. Stay calm when plans change, don't sulk, talk things through. Emotional maturity is rarer and more attractive than looks.
